#Problem 2

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

mr_trash_df = 
  readxl::read_excel("./202610 Trash Wheel Collection Data.xlsx", sheet = "Mr. Trash Wheel", range = "A2:N742") |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  drop_na(dumpster) |>
  mutate(
    sports_balls = as.integer(round(sports_balls)),
    year = as.numeric(year),
    trash_wheel = "Mr Trash")

professor_trash_df =
  readxl::read_excel("./202610 Trash Wheel Collection Data.xlsx", sheet = "Professor Trash Wheel", range = "A2:M139") |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  drop_na(dumpster) |>
  mutate(
    plastic_bottles = as.numeric(plastic_bottles),
    trash_wheel = "Professor Trash")

gwynnda_df = 
  readxl::read_excel("./202610 Trash Wheel Collection Data.xlsx", sheet = "Gwynnda the Good Wheel of the W", range = "A2:L394") |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  drop_na(dumpster) |>
  mutate(trash_wheel = "Gwynnda")

combined_df =
  bind_rows(mr_trash_df, professor_trash_df, gwynnda_df) |> 
  relocate(trash_wheel)

combined_df

#went from A2 headers to N742 last row of possible data excluding the totals row
#also added the sheet option
#clean names makes it snake case

#only including dumpster rows (drop_na), mutating so that the number of sports balls is rounded
#labeling each trash wheel as different names

#years can't combine in between sheets so need to fix
#also similar issue with plastic bottles

#clarifying names
```
```{r}

total_weight_professor = 
  combined_df |>
  filter(trash_wheel == "Professor Trash") |>
  pull(weight_tons) |>
  sum(na.rm = TRUE)

print(total_weight_professor)

total_cigarette_gwynnda =
  combined_df |> 
  filter(trash_wheel == "Gwynnda", month == "June", year == "2022") |>
  pull(cigarette_butts) |>
  sum(na.rm = TRUE)
  
print(total_cigarette_gwynnda)

```
